# Relative Reconstruction Improvement (RRI) {#rri-theory}

This dossier preserves the external motivation and points to the canonical
ARIA-NBV treatment. The definition, equations, target conditioning, and
evidence status are owned by the [Typst thesis](../../typst/thesis/main.typ)
and its oracle/method sections. Do not treat this Quarto page as a current
contract.

RRI compares reconstruction quality before and after an additional view; the
VIN-NBV literature provides the motivating quality-oriented formulation
[@VIN-NBV-frahm2025]. Surface-distance background is retained in
[surface metrics](surface_metrics.qmd). Current metric behavior and acceptance
checks are defined by Python docstrings and tests, not by this page.

See `docs/typst/thesis/development/roadmap.typ` for the current strategic gate
view and `docs/typst/thesis/sections/01-research-questions.typ` for the
research-question context. Executable RRI contracts remain in the Python source
and tests referenced by those owners.
